election_identity.verification: config/races.json identifies the Senate contest as special and Governor as regular for the November 3, 2026 general election. Florida Election Watch currently labels the election 2026 General Election / Unofficial Election Night Results.

provider_family: Florida Department of State, Florida Election Watch (official; county pages and download page located, live result payloads inaccessible in this investigation)

source.official_home_claims: The Florida Department of State's Election Watch page identifies the November 3, 2026 general election as unofficial election-night results, says it displays votes collected from Florida counties, and states preliminary results will not be released before 8:00 p.m. Eastern Time.
source.official_download_claims: The official Downloads page search-index text lists Excel, tab-delimited, and pipe-delimited files including a Votes File. The actual links and whether these are live county-level results could not be inspected.
source.official_county_claims: The official home page exposes county links in the form /TrackCounty/{three-letter county code}; the Florida Election Watch County Results page is independently indexed. County pages were not readable from direct requests during this investigation.
source.official_data_extract_claims: The Florida Division of Elections results extract utility describes a tab-delimited extract with CountyCode, CountyName, race, candidate, vote, and precinct fields. The 2026 November 3 utility response was blocked before its contents or download behavior could be verified.

fetches.result: Homepage HTML was retrievable. It identified the November 3, 2026 general election and unofficial election-night results, stated preliminary results would not be released before 8 p.m. ET, and included county-page links. No candidate vote totals were present in the body. Saved response sample: /tmp/fl-official-home-2026-11-04.html.

Cloudflare managed challenge page; no file links or download URLs could be extracted. No challenge bypass attempted. Search indexing confirms the page lists Excel, tab-delimited, and pipe-delimited election files, including a Votes File, but live availability and row contents are unverified.
Cloudflare managed challenge page; no county race rows or candidate votes were available to inspect. County-code path is linked from the official homepage.

Cloudflare managed challenge page; no tab-delimited rows or sample votes obtained. The endpoint shape is surfaced by the official Division of Elections utility for date-based results extracts, but the November 3, 2026 data was not verified.

county_coverage.note: Official Florida Election Watch publishes county-specific TrackCounty pages and claims its site displays county-submitted votes. No accessible live county response with Senate special or Governor candidate votes was obtained, so neither county coverage nor vote totals are verified.

license.official_source: No explicit reuse license for election-night result files or the live pages was established in this investigation.

limitations: No verified usable public live county-vote JSON, CSV, TSV, XML, or other data response for either requested contest was retrieved.
The official Downloads and TrackCounty routes returned Cloudflare challenges; no challenge bypass was attempted.
The statewide Division of Elections download utility documents county fields but its November 3, 2026 response was also blocked, and it was not verified as a live county-by-county data feed.
Search-indexed descriptions establish that the official pages and downloadable result formats exist, but do not prove that either requested race has reported county votes in the accessible payload.
No secondary mirror was found with verifiable current county votes. Do not use historical or test data as a substitute.

preferred_verified_source.provider: Reported election returns via The New York Times
preferred_verified_source.message: 67 counties with published returns. Source times apply to the published race feed; individual local update times are not supplied. Unofficial counts; no forecast or expected-vote estimates are included.
